item.name: 00_Auth_Setup

item.name: 20b_Negative_Tests_Auth

exec: pm.test("Message contains email format", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Định dạng email"); });
pm.test("Message contains 6 ky tu", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("6 ký tự"); });
pm.test("Message contains email da dang ky", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("đã được đăng ký"); });
pm.test("Message contains so dien thoai da su dung", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Số điện thoại"); });
pm.test("Message contains khong chinh xac", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("không chính xác"); });

item.description: Negative tests for module Auth: 400 (validation), 401 (credentials/refresh/Google), 404 (user not found), 405 (wrong method), 409 (duplicate email/phone), 502 (Google exchange fail).
